summary: This tool is an enhanced Go standard library JSON package that can be imported as a library or fetched via the Go CLI. It builds on the existing encoding/json implementation and adds performance‑focused features, leveraging the Go ecosystem. It is best suited for Go developers needing a faster, more flexible JSON encoder/decoder in production code. The biggest strength is its massive community adoption (139k stars) and mature codebase, while the lack of published benchmarks and limited test coverage are notable drawbacks.
